evidence: Isolation: task/task.toml lines 26-28 `[verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0 / environment_mode = "separate"`; lines 37-38 `[verifier.environment] network_mode = "public"`; no allowed_hosts, allow_internet or docker_image key anywhere in task.toml (public network, no allowlist required per workbook row 10 and SKILL.md line 26). Credential block: task.toml lines 30-35 read exactly `REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code"`, `REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api"`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""` - five keys, same order and values as the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md lines 66-71; `diff` of the frozen template task.toml against the task task.toml shows differences only in [task]/[metadata] identity lines (5-7, 10-12, 14-15), so [verifier], [verifier.env] and [verifier.environment] are byte-identical to the template (od dump confirms LF endings, plain ASCII, no extra keys). The token is the `${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` placeholder, not a literal; grep for `sk-or-`/`sk-ant-` across the task returns nothing. Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty): bases `node:22-bookworm-slim` and `python:3.12-slim`, npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281`, `@openai/codex@0.151.0`, `@playwright/mcp@0.0.79`, `express@5.1.0`, `better-sqlite3@12.4.1`, pip `harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7`, Chromium installed by the pinned Playwright CLI bundled with @playwright/mcp; `COPY . /tests` with `chmod -R go-rwx /tests`. tests/.dockerignore, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and tests/scoring.toml are also byte-identical to the template. test.sh lines 63-64 refuse to grade unless REWARDKIT_JUDGE and REWARDKIT_MODEL are set and nothing in test.sh overrides them. Judge files: all five judge.toml [judge] tables parsed with tomllib contain only judge="claude-code", mode="batched", timeout (600/600/9000/900/900), isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md" plus mcp_servers; grep `^\s*(model|reasoning_effort|temperature)\s*=` over tests/*/*/judge.toml has no hit, and the only `weight =` lines are per-criterion weights, not [judge].weight. The agent image (task/environment/Dockerfile, identical to template) copies only instructions/ and assets/, so no judge client or credentials reach the agent side. Observations that do not change the verdict: (a) base images are pinned by tag rather than digest and apt packages are unversioned - both are template-controlled, identical to the frozen template, and the workbook's check-dockerfiles row treats unpinned apt as a NOTE; (b) the Dockerfile writes a /root/.codex/config.toml with `model_reasoning_effort = "max"` for the unused codex CLI - shared template content, not a judge.toml model and not selected by REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code. Evidence limits: this row is a static wiring check and was verified on the frozen bytes; the raw-evidence index has no configured-judge run on these bytes (only scripted golden checks in the agent image and a hosted run on an earlier candidate, whose verifier files are not claimed identical), so no claim is made here that the verifier image builds or that the OpenRouter credential resolves at run time - that belongs to rows 22/47 and the runtime records. Weak/alternative probes for this row: a judge.toml with a `model` key, a literal key in ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, a non-empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, an added allowed_hosts list, or environment_mode other than separate would each be a defect; none is present.
